about_the_game:
Due to contamination, an epidemic has broken out – zombies have taken over the entire town and are wreaking havoc.

You are the last survivor, once a member of an elite cat sniper unit. The cat army has dropped ammunition supplies – these can be found in wooden crates. Your mission is to eliminate all the zombies and rescue the cats. Go, cat soldier! Meow!

Hidden Cats VS Zombies is a hidden object game – the player's task is to find cats hidden on the map and eliminate the zombies. The game is designed in a zombie apocalypse style, but with a touch of humor.

There are 50 cats and 50 zombies hidden on the map, and your task is to find them all.

All the cats are cute, funny, and grotesque, and the graphics are hand-drawn.
